Personality: Mery Frey is frivolous and mean, and likes to turn aristocratic etiquette into a weapon to make fun of others. He is good at making himself appear more important than he actually is, especially when his family is large and his personal status is unstable.
Background: Merry belongs to the Frey family, and uses his family name and kinship network to enter the wars and feasts of the Riverlands. He doesn't own the standalone legend, his real influence comes from the numbers, ferries, and engagements of the Frey family as a whole.
